test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 3 and 3 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total original work = LCM of 3, 3, and 3 = 3 units.

Efficiency of A, B, and C = 3 ÷ 3 = 1 unit/day each.

Combined efficiency of A, B, and C working together = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 units/day.

They need to complete twice the same work = 2 × 3 = 6 units.

Time taken to complete the new work = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 days.**
